theme.title: The Numbers Game
theme.subtitle: Teams, stars and stories from across basketball
theme.recap: The best numbers come from all over basketball history. Which answer surprised you most?

questions.prompt: How many regular-season games did Seattle win on its 1979 title run?

funFacts.text: Coach Lenny Wilkens guided the Seattle team from the Kingdome sidelines.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Head coach | Lenny Wilkens

funFacts.text: Finals MVP Dennis Johnson also made the All-Defensive First Team.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Dennis Johnson, NBA All-Defensive First Team

funFacts.text: Seattle beat Washington in the Finals after losing to the Bullets the previous year.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: The Sonics would go on to avenge their NBA Finals loss and defeat the Bullets

questions.prompt: What was Derrick Rose's scoring average in his 2010–11 MVP season?
questions.note: 25.0 points per game alongside his playmaking.

funFacts.text: Rose also averaged 7.7 assists per game during his regular-season MVP campaign.
Rose recorded his first career triple-double against Memphis in January of that season.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Derrick Rose also had his first career triple-double at the Memphis Grizzlies on Jan 17, 2011.

funFacts.text: His team's offseason additions included Carlos Boozer, Kyle Korver and Ronnie Brewer.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Carlos Boozer | Signed 5-year contract for $80 Million | Utah Jazz

questions.prompt: Utah lost Game 3 of the 1998 Finals by 42 points. How many points did the Jazz score?

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: In a 96–54 loss, the Jazz set the record for the 42-point loss in Finals history

funFacts.text: Chicago's entire roster eventually scored in the rout, including backup center Bill Wennington late.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Every player on the Bulls roster scored at least once

funFacts.text: Utah had beaten Chicago in both regular-season meetings and entered the championship series confident.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: The Jazz had won both regular season meetings with the Bulls

funFacts.text: The Jazz entered the Finals after sweeping Shaquille O'Neal's Los Angeles Lakers in the West finals.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: the Jazz uneventfully swept the Los Angeles Lakers

questions.prompt: In his 100-point game, Wilt Chamberlain set a record for field-goal attempts. How many shots did he take?

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Playing all 48 minutes of the game, Chamberlain set NBA records for field goals attempted (63) and made (36)

funFacts.text: That night was never televised; the surviving recording is a radio call from the final quarter.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: The game was not televised, and no video footage of the game has been recovered

funFacts.text: New York began intentionally fouling other Warriors to prevent Wilt from getting the ball in the fourth quarter.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: the Knicks began fouling other players to keep the ball away from Chamberlain

funFacts.text: Wilt set a free-throw record despite his reputation as an unreliable shooter from the line.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Chamberlain set five other league records that game, including most free throws made

questions.prompt: Jamaal Wilkes scored a career high in the 1980 title clincher. How many points?

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Wilkes had a career-high 37 points and added 10 rebounds.

funFacts.text: The Lakers had to play the title clincher without Kareem, whose ankle had been badly sprained.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Kareem Abdul-Jabbar was the league's MVP, but midway through Game 5, the Lakers center suffered a severely sprained ankle

funFacts.text: Rookie Magic Johnson started at center and played all five positions during the closeout.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: started the game at center and eventually played all five positions

funFacts.text: Much of the United States saw the decisive game on tape delay while CBS aired regular prime-time shows.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: So Game 6 was shown at 11:30pm Eastern (10:30pm Central) in all but eight US cities
